issues.jp_before: いってらっしゃい。気[き]を{つけて|cl-tsukeru}ね。
issues.problem: English 'Have a good trip' over-translates いってらっしゃい, which is an everyday send-off.
issues.action: English changed to 'See you later. Take care.'

issues.jp_before: 煮物[にもの]の味[あじ]を{つける|cl-tsukeru}のは、母[はは]の役目[やくめ]です。
issues.problem: 煮物の味をつける is awkward; the collocation is 煮物に味をつける. 'stew' is a loose gloss for 煮物.
issues.action: Changed の to に; English now 'Seasoning the simmered dishes is my mother's job.'

issues.jp_before: やけどをした所[ところ]に、すぐ薬[くすり]を{つけて|cl-tsukeru}ください。
issues.problem: The why ('you drink a pill, not a burn') is garbled.
issues.action: Rewrote the why: 飲む is only for medicine taken by mouth.

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]ジョギングをして、足[あし]の力[ちから]を{つけました|cl-tsukeru}。
issues.problem: 足の力をつける sounds unnatural; natives say 体力/脚力をつける.
issues.action: Rewrote as 体力をつけました, 'built up my stamina', and updated the why.

issues.jp_before: 試合[しあい]に勝[か]つために、まず基礎[きそ]の力[ちから]を{つける|cl-tsukeru}必要[ひつよう]があります。
issues.problem: 基礎の力 is stilted; the normal word is 基礎力.
issues.action: Changed to 基礎力[きそりょく]をつける.
